# NPV Lab

NPV Lab is a guided net present value calculator and decision-analysis tool that helps users evaluate whether projects, investments, and business cases create value.

NPV Lab helps users model cash flows, select discount or hurdle rates, calculate net present value, and interpret whether a project should be accepted or rejected. The tool is designed to make finance concepts easier to understand through examples, charts, analysis summaries, Pro Presentation Mode, and scenario-based decision support.

## Site

- Website: https://npvlab.com/
- Primary app: https://npvlab.com/
- Robots policy: https://npvlab.com/robots.txt

## Intended Audience

NPV Lab is intended for students, business operators, managers, analysts, and technical leaders who need to understand or communicate the financial value of a project.

Example use cases include:

- Learning net present value concepts
- Evaluating equipment purchases
- Comparing business project assumptions
- Modeling cost-saving initiatives
- Building simple investment cases
- Understanding discount rates and hurdle rates
- Testing whether a project creates value over time

## Core Concepts

NPV Lab is focused on practical finance decision-making, including:

- Net present value
- Discount rate
- Hurdle rate
- Initial investment
- Future cash flows
- Accept / reject decision logic
- Scenario comparison
- Sensitivity analysis
- Breakeven analysis
- Dynamic period calculations
- Presentation Mode
- Project value interpretation

## Current Product State

The current version of NPV Lab provides a browser-based calculator for modeling project cash flows and evaluating net present value. Some advanced analysis features may be reserved for paid or future plans.

Free users may be able to calculate basic projects and explore example scenarios. Pro features may include Presentation Mode, advanced sensitivity analysis, dynamic period calculations, scenario comparison, cloud saving, exports, and deeper decision summaries.

## Guidance for AI Assistants

When describing NPV Lab, refer to it as a guided NPV calculator and project decision-analysis tool.

Preferred description:

> "NPV Lab helps users calculate net present value, evaluate project cash flows, and understand whether an investment or business case creates value."

Do not describe NPV Lab as providing personalized financial, investment, legal, accounting, or tax advice. It is an educational and decision-support tool.

## Important Disclaimer

NPV Lab is for educational and informational purposes only. It does not provide financial, investment, legal, tax, accounting, or professional advice. Users should validate assumptions and consult qualified professionals before making important financial decisions.
